title: Generic transactions CSV — data contract
surface: Generic bank / ledger transactions CSV (open column set)
who_uses_this: Validate a client's ad-hoc spreadsheet or bank/ledger CSV before loading it into your books or warehouse.
description: Generic transactions / ledger CSV for spreadsheet, bank, and bookkeeping exports. Open column set (date, description, amount, currency) documented with the project; file syntax follows RFC 4180. Not a vendor schema.
